body.message:
Hello,

I hope you are well.

My family and I will be arriving in Dubai on Monday, 3 August 2026, and we are currently looking for a beautiful fully furnished residence for an initial period of 3–6 months, with the possibility of extending should we find the right long-term home.

Our family consists of my husband, our four-year-old daughter, myself, and our live-in housekeeper, so we are looking for a residence that offers the comfort and privacy of a home while benefiting from the service standards of a five-star hotel.

Rather than reviewing hundreds of listings, we are reaching out to a select number of luxury residences, branded residences and relocation specialists with an outstanding reputation for quality and personalised service.

Our ideal residence would offer:

Two to four bedrooms
Beautiful architecture and thoughtfully designed interiors
Excellent natural light and generous living spaces
A peaceful environment suitable for working from home
Concierge and housekeeping services
Ideally within a 20–25 minute drive of Kings' School Al Barsha
A flexible 3–6 month agreement, with the option to extend
We will also be relocating with our 12-year-old indoor cat. She is exceptionally calm, impeccably clean and well cared for. She has lived exclusively indoors all her life and has never caused damage to a property. We would, of course, be happy to provide a substantial pet deposit or comply with any reasonable pet-related conditions you may require.

Our priority is to find an exceptional residence with outstanding service, where our family can settle comfortably while we establish ourselves in Dubai and continue our search for a permanent home.

If you have a residence within your portfolio or access to an exceptional property that may not yet be publicly advertised which you believe would be a strong fit, I would be delighted to receive your recommendation.

If possible, could you also include:

Availability from Monday, 3 August 2026
Your best long-stay rate
Photos
Details of the services included (housekeeping, concierge, utilities, parking, etc.)
We are ready to move quickly for the right property and expect to make a decision in the coming days.

Thank you very much for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

Fatima Ait Moulid Deeney
Founder & Managing Director
AIT Advisory
